title: Better Call Saul
features:
[FEATURES]
- Auto Farm: Automatically cycles through Chest, Arms, Abs, Legs,
and Back workouts. Starts workouts remotely, spams stamina, and
triggers maximum strength reps.
- Auto Eat: Teleports to a seat in the Food Area, automatically
grabs plates, and automatically eats them to grow your total
Stamina stat. Auto upgrades plates dynamically.
- Auto Rank Up: Automatically prestiges when all muscle progress
reaches 100%, and restarts farming.
- Infinite Stamina: Bypasses stamina depletion, allows non-stop
working out.
- Auto Fight: Remote starts fights and spams clicks to maximize
win multipliers.

Need to hide the interface? Press 'Insert' or 'Right Shift'.
